name: fantasy-mcp
description: Read-only access to your ESPN fantasy football team, matchup, free agents, players, standings, and league scoring rules. Set it up in chat: just ask Claude to connect your league.

espn_s2.title: espn_s2 cookie
espn_s2.description: Optional — or ask Claude to set up your league in chat. Copy from your browser's cookies for espn.com (dev tools → Application → Cookies) while logged in to ESPN. Step-by-step: https://github.com/jolfr/fantasy-football-mcp#get-your-espn-cookies-and-league-id

swid.title: SWID cookie
swid.description: Optional — or ask Claude to set up your league in chat. Same place as espn_s2. Keep the curly braces, e.g. {1234ABCD-...}.

league_id.title: League ID
league_id.description: Optional — or ask Claude to set up your league in chat. The leagueId=... number in your league's URL on fantasy.espn.com.

season.title: Season (optional)
season.description: Defaults to the current calendar year (e.g. 2026). Set it during Jan-Jul to keep looking at last season.

team_id.title: Team ID (optional)
team_id.description: Leave blank to auto-detect your team from your SWID, or enter the teamId=... number from your team's URL.
